$comment: Which raster renders exist for each case-study cover. Hand-edited: add an aspect here, run `npm run covers:render`, commit the images. scripts/validate-cover-rasters.mjs holds this file, the case-study cover map, and the files on disk to each other.

card.use: The card cover slot — the /work grid and the Card showcase. Cards sit in a multi-column grid, so 1600px is roughly 3x a typical card and 2x the widest one.

feature.use: The home page's featured card and the robr0-ds hero. Every study is listed here, not just today's featured one, because the home page features caseStudies[0] — reordering the registry must not leave a study without its render.

wide.use: The two Meta case-study heroes, which call for 16:9 rather than the 16:10 the others use.
